protocol: PROSPECTIVE CANONICAL-BROWSER CANDIDATE FREEZE — DESCRIPTOR AUDIT V2

canonicalBrowserRuntime.runnerImageVersionPolicy: record actual ImageVersion in every replicate; all three must match or freeze fails
canonicalBrowserRuntime.browserVersionPolicy: record actual version in every replicate; all three must match or freeze fails; never choose based on localization performance
canonicalBrowserRuntime.pixelReadback: ImageData Uint8ClampedArray RGBA8; RGB8 derived by dropping alpha
canonicalBrowserRuntime.referenceCacheLineage: unchanged Dashen main-v15 z5 production tile/reference lineage using tools/build_dashen_reference_audit_cache.py for CI-local transport only

inputs.hashContract: Owner-recording family freezes the already-established byte-exact 192x192 final work-canvas pixel hashes. East Cross, historical General Shrine and Fang Xu freeze exact existing GitHub-hosted replay/source payload hashes plus the fixed 192x192 rendering rule. Their resulting work-canvas hashes are recorded and must be identical across all three replicates before acceptance. No input may be reacquired.

candidateSelection.searchRule: For every evaluable control execute the unchanged production global search exactly once per replicate and capture its complete final TOP-8 population/order. Membership and ordering come only from unchanged production search.
candidateSelection.candidateIdRule: deterministic SHA-256-derived identifier over control id + production rank + exact x/y/angle/radius numeric geometry; descriptor-independent
candidateSelection.wrongSet: ALL production final TOP-8 entries classified WRONG; additionally include the production final winner only if it is not already represented in TOP-8

optionalD0DominatorLabel.definition: Within the frozen v2 population only, a WRONG candidate Pareto-dominates frozen GT when it is >= GT in both scaleAwareStructure and intensityNcc and strictly > in at least one.

D0.name: V2_CANONICAL_BROWSER_CURRENT_PRIMITIVE_BASELINE
D0.productionCombinedDefinition: unchanged production .92*scaleAwareStructure + .08*intensityScore; intensityNcc is persisted separately exactly as produced by the unchanged photometric scorer

repeatability.ifExceeded: measure actual max/range and return VF1; do not widen tolerance

D1.name: LOCAL_CENSUS_ORDINAL
D1.samples: all integer offsets (dy,dx), dy=-3..3 outer loop then dx=-3..3, excluding (0,0), exactly 48 bits
D1.validity: center and all samples inside common support
D1.score: equal source/reference bits / 48, averaged uniformly over valid centers

D2.name: UNSIGNED_GRADIENT_ORIENTATION
D2.magnitude: sqrt(gx^2+gy^2), divide by support p90 then clip 0..1, epsilon=1e-6
D2.score: weighted mean over common support, null if weight sum<=1e-6

D3.name: SYMMETRIC_EDGE_DISTANCE_CHAMFER
D3.edgeRule: magnitude>=support p85, percentile independently per aligned patch with identical rule
D3.distance: Euclidean distance transform to nearest edge
D3.directed: mean(min(distance,6)/6) from each edge set to other
D3.insufficient: score=null and descriptor coverage failure; no threshold retune

D4.name: SKELETON_NETWORK_DISTANCE
D4.skeleton: deterministic Zhang-Suen thinning; row-major simultaneous deletion each sub-iteration; max 128 full iterations or convergence
D4.distance: same symmetric Euclidean distance-transform formula as D3
D4.insufficient: score=null and descriptor coverage failure; no threshold retune

D5.reason: disabled before outcomes; may not be added later

poseGrid.symmetry: identical grid around GT and every frozen wrong base candidate

finalCases.VF0: V2 CANDIDATE FREEZE COMPLETE — canonical browser candidate population is complete and reproducible; D1-D4 v2 audit is authorized next.
finalCases.VF1: CANONICAL PRODUCTION SEARCH NOT REPEATABLE — candidate population/order/geometry or D0 exceeds frozen repeatability tolerance; descriptor audit remains blocked.
finalCases.VF2: REQUIRED SOURCE/GT GEOMETRY INCOMPLETE — one or more required controls cannot be instantiated provenance-clean; descriptor audit remains blocked.
